description: The player's birthday: all of SERIFU/P_BIRTH.BIN (base 0x801B0000; game-internals 6r), 79 strings. Thirteen sections (fill function in each overlay, e.g. GEKO 0x80134F84, KANGEI 0x80137B90): 0 Yuko, 1 Shiori, 2 a classmate calling 'a girl's here' (read only by KANGEI's copy of the flow), 3 Yuina, 4 Ayako, 5 Mira, 6 Mio, 7 Yukari, 8 Nozomi, 9 Megumi, 10 Saki, 11 nobody gave a present, 12 Yumi (the default for other girls). The girl with the best rank brings a present if that rank is below 2; otherwise section 11 plays. Lines that address a girl end on {G} ('Oh, hi, {G}', 'Gift from {G}') so odd-length names don't show their pair padding mid-line. Verified in DuckStation with tools/emu/force_birthday.py (player's birthday set to 4/25 on the test save, so the scene plays by itself in GEKO.EXN; the girl forced at its selector), hidden emulator: section 11 (natural, nobody) and every girl's present scene, sections 0, 1 and 3-10 and 12. Checked only statically: section 2 (KANGEI's flow), and natural affection-driven choice of the girl.
